sentences.en: I need a little time to rest.
I have been very busy lately.
I am learning to slow down.
A quiet walk helps me relax.
I try to get enough sleep.
I feel refreshed after a good night.
sentences.ar: أشعر بالانتعاش بعد ليلة نوم جيدة.

sentences.en: I take breaks when I need them.
It is important to drink water.
I try to eat regular meals.
Too much screen time makes me tired.
I put my phone away before bed.
I like spending time outdoors.
Fresh air improves my mood.
Sometimes I feel overwhelmed.
sentences.ar: أشعر أحيانًا بأن الأمور تفوق طاقتي.

sentences.en: I can take one step at a time.
sentences.ar: يمكنني التعامل مع الأمور خطوة بخطوة.

sentences.en: Talking to someone I trust helps.
sentences.ar: التحدث مع شخص أثق به يساعدني.

sentences.en: I do not have to do everything today.
sentences.ar: ليس عليّ إنجاز كل شيء اليوم.

sentences.en: My health deserves attention.
I am trying to be kinder to myself.
sentences.ar: أحاول أن أكون ألطف مع نفسي.

sentences.en: Making mistakes is part of learning.
I am grateful for small moments.
I enjoy a quiet cup of tea.
I want a better work-life balance.
sentences.ar: أريد توازنًا أفضل بين العمل والحياة.

sentences.en: I can say no when I need to.
sentences.ar: يمكنني قول لا عندما أحتاج إلى ذلك.

sentences.en: Rest is not a waste of time.
I will plan something enjoyable this week.
A short break can change my day.
I am paying attention to my energy.
Some days are harder than others.
I try not to judge myself too harshly.
sentences.ar: أحاول ألّا أحكم على نفسي بقسوة.

sentences.en: A simple routine helps me feel steady.
sentences.ar: يساعدني الروتين البسيط على الشعور بالاستقرار.

sentences.en: I will reach out if I need support.
I deserve a moment of calm.
Tomorrow I can begin again.
sentences.ar: يمكنني أن أبدأ من جديد غدًا.

sections.heading: A new situation
paragraphs: Dina was learning how to handle well-being in everyday English. The goal was to communicate clearly and politely.
